rewrites.why: A save that sends a description whose steps intervals.icu parses into a workout_doc stores intervals.icu's own Load estimate from those steps in place of the sent icu_training_load. A ride added with Load 21 read back 16, and an edit that set authored steps after a Load of 33 read back 22. A save that sends no description keeps the sent Load: an edit of icu_training_load alone read back 33, and a strength session or a seeded workout with a description of no steps keeps its Load.

A save that sends a description and no workout_doc stores a workout_doc that intervals.icu builds from that description. A description with steps reads back with those steps, and a description with no steps reads back with a document whose steps list is empty and whose duration is 0, not with no workout_doc.
